{{Top|leg}}
A '''Pleader''' was a legal advocate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] assigned to represent criminals.

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Iving Creel]] was a famous Pleader on the planet Concord Dawn. He defended in a trial court an unrepentant [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protector]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], going by the name [[Jaster Mereel]], who had murdered a fellow Protector.
